newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Share trade to resume in Portugal's Lisnave.
newsitem.headline: Share trade to resume in Portugal's Lisnave.

text.p: Share trade will resume in Portuguese ship repair company Lisnave at 1330 GMT, dealers said.
The bourse halted trade this morning apparently because of a television interview given by company chairman Jose de Mello.

De Mello said in the interview that the company was bankrupt and all its shareholders would have to bear the loss from its proposed capital reduction -- part of a state-backed restructuring programme which will split the company in two.
The company last month announced a drastic reduction in its capital to 3.6 billion escudos from 35.6 billion.
Lisnave has announced that it plans to set up a new operating company for the ship repair business which will absorb only part of the workforce currently on its books.
